title: On the Vanishing of the Brauer-Manin Obstruction for Normic Bundles
summary: We study the behaviour of the Brauer--Manin obstruction to the existence of rational points under finite field extensions. For $(p, mp)$-normic bundles over number fields, we prove that the Brauer--Manin obstruction vanishes after base change to finite extensions whose degrees satisfy suitable $p$-divisibility conditions depending on $m$. We further show that, for $(p,2p)$-normic bundles with $p=2$ or $3$, it is enough to assume that the extension degree is divisible by $p$.
